feed.title: Massachusetts: MGM responds to Springfield’s lawsuit over Host Community Agreement
feed.summary: MGM Springfield officials have filed a lawsuit against MGM Resorts International and Blue Tarp Redevelopment in response to Springfield's claims of "non-compliance issues" with their Host Community Agreement. Springfield Mayor Domenic Sarno initiated the legal action after nearly two years of unresolved negotiations, emphasizing the city's commitment to its residents' best interests. The lawsuit aims to resolve disputes surrounding the 2013 agreement required for casino operation in Massachusetts.

feed.title: McKesson Data Breach: Investigation Ongoing
feed.summary: McKesson Corp., a major healthcare company, disclosed a cybersecurity incident in late August 2026 involving unauthorized access to third-party applications and data exfiltration. A threat actor named ShinyHunters claimed responsibility. McKesson is providing credit monitoring and identity protection services to potentially affected individuals, though the specific types of personal information compromised have not yet been fully determined.

feed.title: Intel '100% committed' to getting New Albany fab completed, Moreno says
feed.summary: U.S. Sen. Bernie Moreno expressed renewed confidence in Intel's commitment to completing its New Albany computer chip plant, despite previous delays and his initial skepticism. After contacting Intel's CEO last year, Moreno now believes the company is "100% committed" to fulfilling its promises, even though the completion date has been pushed to 2031. He also highlighted the U.S. government's equity stake in Intel, asserting it provides a better approach than mere handouts for such large projects.

feed.title: Trailing rivals, AbbVie scores win with dual-acting myeloma drug
feed.summary: AbbVie announced positive Phase 3 clinical trial results for its dual-acting multiple myeloma drug, etentamig, showing it extended progression-free survival compared to standard treatments. The drug also demonstrated a better safety profile with lower rates of serious immune responses, potentially allowing for broader use in community oncology settings. This positions etentamig as a strong contender despite trailing rival bispecific antibodies from Johnson & Johnson, Pfizer, and Regeneron.

feed.title: Lululemon one of bigger victims in downside in athletic wear, says Wells Fargo’s Ike Boruchow
feed.summary: Wells Fargo senior retail analyst Ike Boruchow suggests that Lululemon is significantly impacted by the downturn in the athletic wear sector. This assessment comes after Lululemon reported another quarter of disappointing earnings and a sales slowdown, indicating ongoing struggles for the company. Boruchow's comments highlight Lululemon's vulnerability in the current market climate.

feed.title: Tesla Cybercabs face safety probe as regulators question driverless taxi compliance
feed.summary: Federal regulators have initiated an investigation into Tesla's new "Cybercab" driverless taxis, questioning their compliance with safety standards. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) is examining whether the two-seater vehicles, which lack steering wheels, mirrors, or brake pedals, meet federal requirements. This probe comes just one day after Tesla launched the service in Austin, Texas, causing the company's stock to fall by over 5%.

feed.title: She boarded the ship. Her cruise was canceled before it ever set sail
feed.summary: A Royal Caribbean cruise to Alaska was canceled due to a mechanical issue after passengers had already embarked, leaving them stranded in Vancouver. The cruise line offered full refunds and future cruise credits, but passengers faced difficulties rebooking travel arrangements. This incident follows a similar cancellation by Disney Cruise Line in May, highlighting that while rare, such events do occur.

The company will discuss its pipeline of therapies for heart disease, including gene therapies for HCM and ARVC, and a small molecule inhibitor for HFpEF and DMD.

feed.title: BASF Units Bring Patent Suit Against Apple Over Face ID Tech
feed.summary: Two units of BASF SE, TrinamiX Sensing LLC and trinamiX GmbH, have filed a patent infringement lawsuit against Apple Inc. They allege that Apple's Face ID technology in various iPhone and iPad models infringes on seven of their patents related to optical skin detection and material identification. The complaint was filed in the US District Court for the Western District of Texas, specifically naming the iPhone 15, 16, 17 series, and recent iPad Pro models.

feed.title: Costco August sales up 9,9% amid higher gas prices, digital growth
feed.summary: Costco Wholesale Corp. reported a 9.9% increase in net sales for August, reaching $23.70 billion, with strong digital growth and higher gas prices contributing to the momentum. Comparable sales rose 8.4% globally, with significant growth in the U.S. and in digitally enabled transactions. The company also noted the impact of a later Labor Day on sales figures and highlighted strong performance in non-food categories and ancillary businesses like gas and pharmacy.

feed.title: UNCY INVESTOR ALERT: Class Action Lawsuit Filed on Behalf of Unicycive Therapeutics, Inc. Investors – Holzer & Holzer, LLC Encourages Investors With Losses to Contact the Firm
feed.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Unicycive Therapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ: UNCY) by Holzer & Holzer, LLC. The lawsuit alleges that Unicycive made false and misleading statements regarding its third-party manufacturing vendor's compliance with good manufacturing practices, which likely led to delays in the regulatory approval of oxylanthanum carbonate. Investors who purchased Unicycive shares between December 29, 2025, and June 29, 2026, and incurred losses are encouraged to contact Holzer & Holzer, LLC.

The brand's offerings include the MeowGo G50 Max, an advanced 5G satellite mobile Wi-Fi hotspot with AI assistant capabilities and satellite SMS messaging, as well as a range of multi-in-one lifestyle devices designed for continuous, global connectivity. These innovations aim to provide reliable internet access for travelers and remote workers, even in challenging environments.

feed.title: A system trained on millions of animal sounds reads pets' cues. uCloudlink showed it in Berlin.
feed.summary: uCloudlink, through its pet-tech brand petpogo, announced a full upgrade to its AI pet technology ecosystem at IFA 2026 in Berlin. This ecosystem, comprising the PetPhone wearable, PetCam AI camera, and petpogo mobile app, interprets pet movements and vocalizations using a database of millions of animal sounds to provide emotional insights and enhanced safety features like proactive geofencing alerts. The system aims to strengthen bonds between humans and pets by offering continuous emotional understanding, safety, and interaction solutions.

feed.title: Western Digital (WDC) Down 2.2% Since Last Earnings Report: Can It Rebound?

Despite this, the company reported strong Q4 fiscal 2026 earnings, beating estimates with significant revenue growth driven by increased customer storage demand, especially for AI and cloud-driven needs. The company also provided encouraging guidance for Q1 fiscal 2027, expecting continued revenue growth and improved margins, leading to a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) rating.

feed.title: L3Harris completes first batch of F-16 Viper Shield systems
feed.summary: L3Harris Technologies has completed the initial production of 35 Viper Shield electronic warfare and countermeasure systems for F-16 aircraft, with 233 units on order for eight allied nations. The system, which offers "digital armour" and is compatible with various F-16 variants and the APG-83 AESA radar, relies on commercial off-the-shelf components for a compact design and easier upgrades. L3Harris highlights foreign investment in the program as a potential cost-saving opportunity for the US Air Force.

feed.title: More than 274K without power in Michigan as more storms expected
feed.summary: Over 274,000 DTE Energy and Consumers Energy customers in Michigan experienced power outages following storms on Thursday, with more severe weather anticipated. DTE aims to restore power to 65% of affected customers by Friday evening, 90% by Saturday, and all by Sunday, deploying thousands of workers. Crews are also assessing potential tornado damage on Detroit's east side.

feed.title: ANET Rises 37.3% in Six Months: Is There More Room to Grow?

The company benefits from increased investment in networking capacity by cloud providers and hyperscalers, and its integrated hardware-and-software approach for complex AI deployments. Arista's proactive supply chain management and robust cash flow further strengthen its position, with expectations for continued growth in AI revenues and product development.

feed.title: Costco's August Sales Rise 9.9% as Digital Growth Stays Strong
feed.summary: Costco Wholesale Corporation reported a 9.9% increase in August net sales, reaching $23.70 billion, driven by resilient consumer demand and strong digital growth. The company's comparable sales rose 8.4% year-over-year, with digital sales up 17.9%. Despite trading at a higher forward P/E ratio than its industry peers, Costco's sales and earnings per share are projected to grow by 9.7% and 13.5% respectively for the current fiscal year.

feed.title: Ulta’s use of Flock technology causes upset online
feed.summary: Ulta Beauty is facing online backlash for its use of Flock automated license plate readers in some stores, despite the technology not using facial recognition and being deployed in less than 1% of its locations. Flock's technology, which helps identify repeat offenders for organized retail crime, has drawn widespread public criticism and led to some local governments reconsidering its installation. Ulta's director of organized retail crime stated the technology helps protect associates and guests by assisting law enforcement in solving crimes faster and proactively preventing incidents.

feed.title: Why Is Zimmer (ZBH) Up 1.8% Since Last Earnings Report?

feed.title: Adobe Sinks 7% as Internal CEO Pick Lands Ahead of Earnings, Workday Falls 4%
feed.summary: Adobe's stock fell 7% after the company named an internal candidate, Anil Chakravarthy, as its new CEO, raising doubts about its AI strategy ahead of its earnings report. Workday also dropped 4% in sympathy, despite strong subscription guidance. This market reaction suggests investors are more concerned with Adobe's specific succession and AI narrative than broader software industry fundamentals, especially given Intuit's recent strong performance.

feed.title: ONEOK (OKE) is Funding a $4.4B Acquisition With a $9B Minority Investment. Is the 7% Capped Return Attractive?
feed.summary: ONEOK (OKE) is acquiring Brazos Midstream's Permian Midland Basin assets for $4.425 billion, funded by a $9 billion nonvoting minority equity investment from Apollo-managed funds. This investment has an internal rate of return (IRR) capped at 7.0% for nine years. The article discusses the financial structure, potential benefits like reduced debt and EPS accretion, and potential risks such as the competing claim on cash flow and the reliance on aggressive growth forecasts for the acquired assets.

feed.title: Live Nation’s $2.4M California Wage Settlement Covers More Than 16,000 Workers
feed.summary: Live Nation Worldwide and HOB Entertainment have agreed to a $2.4 million settlement to resolve a proposed class action lawsuit in California. The suit alleged the companies failed to properly compensate over 16,000 hourly and nonexempt employees by violating various wage-and-hour laws. This settlement, which still requires final court approval, stands in stark contrast to the multi-million dollar compensation packages received by Live Nation's top executives during the same period.

feed.title: ONEOK (OKE) is Funding a $4.4B Acquisition With a $9B Minority Investment. Is the 7% Capped Return Attractive?

feed.title: Experian expands into AI agents with ServiceNow partnership
feed.summary: Experian is expanding its artificial intelligence capabilities by partnering with ServiceNow to deploy a commercial agent-based platform called Agent Operating System. This system aims to integrate Experian's risk, identity, and decision-making services into enterprise workflows, improving efficiency and enabling faster information delivery. Experian emphasizes the secure and controlled nature of its AI agents, ensuring compliance and human oversight, especially in regulated processes.

feed.title: Can TROW's New Securitized Income ETF Boost Fixed-Income Growth?
feed.summary: T. Rowe Price Group (TROW) has launched the T. Rowe Price Securitized Income ETF (TSCZ) to expand its active ETF offerings, aiming to generate income and diversify fixed-income exposure. This new ETF invests in various U.S. securitized credit assets, strengthening TROW's presence in the securitized-credit market. The move is part of TROW's larger strategy to grow its active ETF business, supported by its recent acquisition of F/m Investments LLC, which is expected to significantly increase its fixed-income AUM and ETF offerings.

feed.title: Gilead Keeps Writing Bigger Checks—But Can the Drugs Keep Paying for Them?
feed.summary: Gilead Sciences continues to increase its dividend, supported by strong free cash flow, particularly from its HIV drug Biktarvy. While the company's dividend safety is rated B+ due to its reliable payouts and an extended patent runway for Biktarvy until 2036, it faces concentration risk in its HIV franchise. Gilead is actively working to diversify its revenue through its pipeline, with growth seen in PrEP sales, oncology drug Trodelvy, and liver disease treatment Livdelzi, aiming to build a bridge beyond the eventual patent cliff.

feed.title: General Mills closes sale of Brazil food business
feed.summary: General Mills has completed the sale of its Brazil food business to Grupo 3corações for $153 million, as part of its Accelerate strategy to reshape its product portfolio. The divestiture includes popular brands like Yoki and Kitano, and aims to increase General Mills' operating profit margin and allow its international segment to focus on more profitable global platforms. Grupo 3corações, Brazil's largest coffee company, expects the acquisition to significantly expand its industrial, logistics, and commercial capabilities across Brazil.
